description: A Studio project and its summary state.

status.description: Current processing status of the project.

firstRecordingId.description: ID of the first recording of the project.

expectedLanguages.description: Union of the additional languages declared on the project's recordings.

subtitleProfileId.description: ID of the subtitle profile used by the project.

duration.description: Total duration of the recordings in seconds.

fileCount.description: Number of recordings in the project.

recordingTypes.description: Processing steps that exist on the project.

isPublic.description: Whether every member of the organization can open the project.

reviewProgress.description: Review progress per step (`TRANSCRIPTION`, `TRANSLATION`, `DUBBING`) and language, returned by the project list and the project detail. The project detail lists only the steps and languages of your share of a shared project; the project list counts every step and language of the project. Present when the project has reviewable segments.

totalSegments.description: Number of segments of the language.

reviewedSegments.description: Number of segments whose review status is `REVIEWED`.
